title: Identifying Representational Biases in Datasets Using PCA: A Max-Disparity Partition Framework
abstract: arXiv:2609.24556v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) minimises aggregate reconstruction error, which can inadvertently represent majority subgroups with substantially higher fidelity than minority subgroups. Fairness-aware extensions of PCA correct this disparity but require group labels as input. We address the logically prior question: given only a data matrix, which binary partition of the data suffers the greatest representational disparity under a shared PCA projection? We formalise this as the max-disparity partition problem and propose a greedy local-search algorithm, grounded in the Fiduccia-Mattheyses bipartitioning framework, that discovers the disparity-maximising partition without any predefined group labels. Two benchmark algorithms, a fixed-projection sorting baseline and a simulated-annealing variant, confirm that the greedy solution is empirically near-optimal. translated_title: 使用PCA识别数据集中的表征偏差：一种最大差异划分框架
translated_abstract: 主成分分析（PCA）通过最小化总体重构误差，可能会使多数子群体获得的表征保真度显著高于少数子群体。公平感知的PCA扩展方法可以纠正这种差异，但需要以群体标签作为输入。我们解决了一个逻辑上更前置的问题：仅给定一个数据矩阵，在共享的PCA投影下，数据的哪种二分划分会遭受最大的表征差异？我们将该问题形式化为最大差异划分问题，并提出了一种基于Fiduccia-Mattheyses二分划分框架的贪心局部搜索算法，该算法无需任何预定义的群体标签即可发现使差异最大化的划分。两个基准算法——固定投影排序基线和模拟退火变体——证实了贪心解在经验上接近最优。在识别出该划分后，我们将差异归因于特定特征……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个无需群体标签的最大差异划分框架，通过基于Fiduccia-Mattheyses框架的贪心局部搜索算法，自动发现PCA投影下表征差异最大的数据二分方式，从而识别数据集中隐藏的表征偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a label-free max-disparity partition framework that uses a greedy local-search algorithm grounded in the Fiduccia-Mattheyses framework to automatically identify the binary data partition suffering the greatest representational disparity under PCA projection, thereby uncovering hidden representational biases in datasets.
